description: This file defines multiple configuration options classes related to streaming in Orleans, including lifecycle options, pub/sub options, and pulling agent options, along with nested enumerations.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for managing the lifecycle of the stream system, including initialization and startup stages.

classes.name: StreamLifecycleOptions.RunState
classes.description: Enumerates well-known points in the streaming system's lifecycle: None, Initialized, AgentsStarted, AgentsStopped.

classes.name: StreamPubSubOptions
classes.description: Holds configuration options for stream pub/sub behavior, including the pub/sub type.

classes.name: StreamPullingAgentOptions
classes.description: Contains configuration options for stream pulling agents, such as batch size and timing parameters.
